LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory01: {PAWN_labelShort} is now old enough to carry a pickaxe alone, steal someone else's meat, and blame somebody else when caught. The tribe solemnly struck {PAWN_objective} across the back of the head and handed over every unfinished chore.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory02: {PAWN_labelShort} has reached a useful age in goblin society. There was no congratulatory speech. Instead, {PAWN_pronoun} received a rusty blade, a piece of moldy meat, and a bedroll that would be {PAWN_possessive} if {PAWN_pronoun} returned alive.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory03: {PAWN_labelShort} is no longer a useless mouth. The adults stripped the equipment from a dead goblin, handed it over, and said {PAWN_pronoun} would be recognized as grown if {PAWN_pronoun} returned alive. Nobody explained where {PAWN_pronoun} was expected to return from.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory04: {PAWN_labelShort} has finally grown to a useful size. The adult goblins celebrated by handing {PAWN_objective} tools, a weapon, and every overdue chore at once.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory05: {PAWN_labelShort} is now large enough to carry a weapon in the front rank. The other goblins offered no congratulations, only a rusty weapon and a dangerously important assignment.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory06: {PAWN_labelShort} is old enough to trail behind a raiding party. {PAWN_pronoun} can steal human food, search fallen enemies, and strip equipment from comrades while they are still warm. {PAWN_pronoun} was also advised never to waste the corpse of a goblin from a rival burrow. Meat is precious.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory07: {PAWN_labelShort} is now treated as a proper goblin. {PAWN_pronoun} is old enough to raid human villages, strike rival goblins from behind, and stab a sibling when the loot division feels unfair. {PAWN_pronoun} still needs to learn that naming something before eating it is poor manners.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory08: {PAWN_labelShort} is no longer protected by the burrow. A failed raid means death, a successful raid means a stronger goblin takes the loot, and complaining means becoming dinner. The tribe calls this responsibility.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory09: {PAWN_labelShort} has grown from a hungry runt into a useful goblin. {PAWN_pronoun} may now serve proudly as a tunnel slave, arrow catcher, bullet catcher, or meat shield. Good fortune means stealing loot from a human village. Bad fortune means becoming the next raiding party's provisions. Goblin society values both contributions.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory10: {PAWN_labelShort} can finally carry a pickaxe without help. The tribe immediately granted {PAWN_objective} a collapsing tunnel, a shield already under enemy fire, and the sleeping place of a predecessor who never returned. Survivors become raiders, the fallen become cover, and the dead become meat. No goblin is wasted.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory11: {PAWN_labelShort} has earned the right to raid a human village. More precisely, {PAWN_pronoun} will carry baggage behind the veterans, catch arrows in front of them, and delay pursuers during the retreat. Returning safely may even earn {PAWN_objective} the honor of watching the loot being divided.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory12: {PAWN_labelShort} may now enter a tunnel first when it begins to collapse. The pickaxe belongs to the tribe, but the blisters and broken bones belong entirely to {PAWN_objective}. The tribe hopes {PAWN_pronoun} becomes a fine tunnel worker, or at least a useful marker for unstable ground.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory13: {PAWN_labelShort} can now carry a shield. When no shield is available, {PAWN_pronoun} may stand in its place. Stopping arrows makes {PAWN_objective} a meat shield, stopping bullets makes {PAWN_objective} a bullet catcher, and surviving both is considered evidence of leadership potential.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory14: {PAWN_labelShort} has reached the age of choosing a career. The choices are tunnel slave, arrow catcher, bullet catcher, and meat shield. Refusing to choose results in automatic placement wherever casualties have left an opening. Goblin society is remarkably efficient.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory15: {PAWN_labelShort} is now old enough to raid neighboring burrows, take equipment from dead comrades, and strike a sibling from behind over loot. {PAWN_pronoun} still has to learn the basic courtesy of removing the equipment before eating a comrade.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinGrowthStory16: {PAWN_labelShort} can now dig tunnels, carry baggage, and intercept arrows and bullets meant for someone more important. Survivors become warriors and the dead become provisions. Congratulations: {PAWN_pronoun} is now a fully useful goblin.
